item.title: Visual Gallery
item.description: Telling compelling stories with data is what I love to do. Below, I had some fun creating visuals using publicly available data from the City of Cincinnati Open Data Portal. I hope you enjoy! City Vehicles Using vehicle GPS data from city-owned vehicles (SOURCE DATA), this map tracks these assets as they move around downtown Cincinnati, using R and gganimate. Single Vehicle Multiple Vehicles Adding a trace line for each vehicle reveals some very interesting patterns - we can clearly see police patrols criss-cross different sections of downtown.
